simple.preset.fix.note: Noise and compression blocks always run together. Clean uses both models. Strong uses one model for both. Colours turns white balance and levels on or off together.
setting.job.mode.help: Light and Medium use the clean models. Strong uses the slower model.
setting.job.restore_models.help: Catalogue ids for this cleanup, separated by commas.
setting.job.sharpen.help: How much to emphasise edges. 0.35 is the usual amount.
setting.job.upscale.help: Keep the size, or make the picture twice as big.
setting.job.anime.help: Use the anime model when the picture is twice as big.
setting.job.upscale_model.help: Catalogue id used when the picture is twice as big.
setting.job.codec.help: AV1 is the usual codec. HEVC is only for the GPU encoder.
setting.job.crf.help: AV1 quality. 20 is the usual value. A lower number keeps more detail and makes a larger file. HEVC uses the same number.
setting.job.sigma.help: Denoise strength for the clean models. 15 is light and 25 is medium. The strong model does not read this number.
setting.job.tile.help: Tile size in pixels. 0 chooses it automatically.
setting.job.batch.help: How many frames to restore together.
setting.job.overlap.help: How many pixels the tiles share.
setting.job.quality_factor.help: How hard to clean blocky compression. 40 is the usual value.
setting.job.upscale_strength.help: Blend toward the softer large-picture model. 0 leaves it off.
